name: Okey
description: Okey is the quintessential Turkish tile game of the Rummy family. Played with 106 wooden or plastic tiles numbered 1-13 in four colors, players draw and discard to form sets and runs. A face-up indicator tile determines which tiles act as wild jokers. The first to complete a valid 14-tile hand wins the round.

content.text: Okey is the quintessential Turkish tile game of the Rummy family. Played with 106 wooden or plastic tiles numbered 1-13 in four colors, players draw and discard to form sets and runs. A face-up indicator tile determines which tiles act as wild jokers. The first to complete a valid 14-tile hand wins the round.
Okey derives from 19th-century Levant and Central Asian tile games, sharing ancestry with Rummikub and Mahjong. It stabilised in Ottoman Turkey.
4 players (2-3 possible). Each uses a rack (Istaka).
106 tiles: numbers 1-13 in red, yellow, green, black (8 per number); 2 unmarked false jokers. One 6-sided die.
Tiles mixed face-down, stacked in 21 piles of 5. Dealer throws die twice to select indicator tile. Player to dealer's right gets 15 tiles, others 14. Play proceeds anticlockwise.

items.text: Okey 101: Players receive 21-22 tiles; melds are laid on table. First meld must total at least 101 points.
Partnership Okey: Players opposite are partners; team scoring.
Color Okey: Win with one-color hand doubles score (4 or 8 points lost).
